about: Each candidate item is checked by hand once; its verdict and reason are recorded here and census.py applies them. verdict 'issue' moves the item to the issues column; 'ok' moves it to a reported 'checked, not an issue' row with this reason. An item no decision matches stays a candidate. 'category' is the start of the candidate row's name; 'pattern' a regular expression searched in the item.

decisions.pattern: ^app/market_data/schwab/streaming/capture\.py:\d+: a platform special case: INTERRUPTS = \(signal\.SIGINT, signal\.SIGBREAK\) if sys\.platform == "win32" else \(signal\.SIGINT,\)$
decisions.reason: signal.SIGBREAK exists only on Windows (docs/SOURCES.md python-windows-signals)

decisions.pattern: ^app/market_data/schwab/streaming/program_lock\.py:\d+: a platform special case: if sys\.platform == "win32":$
decisions.reason: the stop is asked by a named event on Windows, where os.kill with any signal but the console events kills the process with no clean stop (python-windows-signals); SIGTERM elsewhere
the token file's replace is tried again briefly when another process holds the file, as pip retries os.replace (pip-replace-retry)

decisions.pattern: ^(feed/schwab_client\.py:\d+: timing worked around \(`time\.sleep`\): time\.sleep\(0\.1\)|launch\.py:\d+: timing worked around \(`time\.sleep`\): time\.sleep\(min\(0\.25, max\(deadline - time_et\.elapsed\(\), 0\)\)\))$
decisions.reason: waits for another process (the sign-in callback's port; the program's ports and pages): no event crosses processes, so a poll with a deadline (fowler-non-determinism)

decisions.pattern: ^stream_spine\.py:\d+: a type guessed at run time \(`hasattr`\): return not hasattr\(error, "sqlite_errorcode"\)
decisions.reason: an error Python's sqlite3 raises itself carries no sqlite_errorcode (a closed connection's ProgrammingError: none; SQLite's own refusal: its code), so the attribute says whether SQLite refused

decisions.pattern: ^(server\.py:\d+: timing worked around \(`time\.sleep`\): time\.sleep\((0\.5|1\.0)\)|stream_spine\.py:\d+: timing worked around \(`time\.sleep`\): time\.sleep\(self\.retry_sec\))$
decisions.reason: a wait inside the program that sleeps past the stop: one the stop sets would end it at once

decisions.pattern: ^tests/(test_console_startup_waits_v1\.py:\d+: a platform special case: WINDOWS = sys\.platform == "win32"|test_data_path_startup_v1\.py:\d+: a platform special case: sys\.platform != "win32", reason="the daemon's (window is a Windows console window|batch and its window are Windows')"|test_launch_v1\.py:\d+: a platform special case: sys\.platform != "win32", reason="console windows and their Ctrl events are Windows'")$

decisions.pattern: ^tests/test_data_path_(capture_whole|writer_failures)_v1\.py:\d+: a platform special case: if sys\.platform == "win32":$
decisions.reason: the disk's refusal is induced per platform: on Windows os.chmod sets only the read-only flag, so a held name or an open handle stands in (python-os-chmod-windows)

decisions.pattern: ^tests/test_data_path_startup_v1\.py:\d+: a platform special case: if sys\.platform != "win32":$
decisions.reason: a process that waits is started with the platform's own shell: cmd on Windows, sh elsewhere

decisions.pattern: ^tests/test_operating_process_lock_v1\.py:\d+: a platform special case: if sys\.platform != "win32":$
decisions.reason: a NUL byte in a path: the guard raises where Linux cannot place it and refuses where Windows does, each run on its own CI runner

decisions.pattern: ^(tests/test_operating_process_lock_v1\.py:\d+: a platform special case: devices = \("echo x > NUL", "echo x > nul"\) if os\.name == "nt" else \(\)|tools/pretooluse_guard\.py:\d+: a platform special case: device = os\.name == "nt" and )
decisions.reason: NUL and CON are devices only on Windows, where os.path.isreserved names them (python-os-path-isreserved)

decisions.pattern: ^tests/test_operator_yes_guard_v1\.py:\d+: a platform special case: unreadable = 4 if os\.name == "nt" else 1
decisions.reason: a process whose command line no user can read: Windows' System process (4), init (1) elsewhere

decisions.pattern: ^tests/test_runtime_governance_decoupling_v1\.py:\d+: an import worked around: except ImportError:$
decisions.reason: the test's own arming: its import hook must refuse tools for the test to prove the server starts without them
